text: Pelulu
Caylass
Princess Nanaka
Sandayu
Celesa
Wow! The flowers are in full bloom! Seeing sakura\nat night is nice too, especially when you haven't\nseen them for a while, isn't it~?
Since we're here, how about taking a little walk?\nThe lakeside looks like it could be a great spot\nfor a picture!
What's wrong? You saw someone?
Oh no...\nWhat should I do with this...
Long time no see, Caylass!\nIt's rare to see you looking so serious and deep\nin thought.
Oh, it's you and Pelulu...Are you here to see the\nnight sakura? Welcome, welcome! But unfortunately,\nI can't accompany you right now.
Looks like you've got a story~. Come on, spill it.\nWe might help if the reward is good enough.
Actually, there's a place called "Leafy Sakura\nVillage" near Night Sakura Garden. Highly skilled\nninjas called the "Leafy Sakura Clan" live there.
And I've been challenged to a duel by the leader.
So, what's the problem?\nI thought you liked stuff like that!
Hey! You really think I don't care who it is,\nas long as I get to punch someone?!
I mean, how could I accept a challenge from a\nweakling like that?!
It seems to me that you don't care, though~.
Well, I admit that I did duel "Sandayu",\nthe former leader of the Leafy Sakura Clan,\nthough.
He put up a good fight, but somehow, I managed to\nbeat him. Then he disappeared. I heard he was\nashamed of his defeat.
His daughter, "Princess Nanaka", the current\nleader, has been relentlessly challenging me to a\nduel to restore her father's honor.
What was the reason you had a duel with Sandayu,\nthough? That's what started this problem, right?
Eh? Er, that's, um...I wonder what it was...
That's kinda fishy~...
Welp, if there's a reward for us, we might be able\nto help. We'll see what we can do to sort it out.\nWhat do you say?
Oh, that'd be great. I'm counting on you, then!
Oh well, what would you do without us?\nWe'll take care of it!
Leafy Sakura Village is located deep in the\nheart of "Mt. Hazakura". You should go there\nfirst.
Got it~!\nLet's hear what Princess Nanaka has to say first!
Caylass! Caylass!\nYou there? We need to talk to you!
Oh, you're back! I've been waiting for you.\nDid everything go well with Princess Nanaka?
What? A giant flying squirrel...with the\nBeastmaster skill? I've heard about it before,\nbut I didn't know it was real.
So it's fast even though it's huge?\nI wonder what kind of strategy I should use.\nI kinda wanna try battling it.
How is it? What did Caylass say?
I knew it!
You know what? That's your weakness. You're so\nstubborn! I heard it all started because you made\na scene in Leafy Sakura Village!!
Besides, Princess Nanaka is a girl, you know?!\nYou shouldn't use violence!!
I know she's a girl, but she's the one who\nchallenged me first.
Besides, I want her to know that she shouldn't\nunderestimate me! I'll make sure to only attack\nthe giant flying squirrel!
And actually...
I didn't mean to eavesdrop...
Princess Nanaka?
Uh-oh...
I heard you talking about things like strategy,\nweakness, and violence...
Did you decide to get here first to give him a\nheads-up about my plan?
What?\nWait a minute!
I'm so disappointed.\nI honestly thought we were friends...\nBut it looks like I've been betrayed.
No, it's not what you think!
I even had a discussion with the former leaders of\nLeafy Sakura, and we all agreed to appoint the\nadventurer as the vice leader...
I told you it's a misunderstanding.\nYou're jumping to conclusions too quickly!
To protect the pride of Leafy Sakura Village,\nI'll fight you!\nPrepare yourself!
Ugh, I lost...
Oh no, you can't even beat someone like the\nadventurer. Obviously, you're not in my league.\nCome back 100 years later!
Excuse me? What's that supposed to mean~?
Princess Nanaka, it was Caylass who started all\nthis. We didn't betray you, you know?
I know. Looking back, if you had really been\nplotting against me, you wouldn't have gone out of\nyour way to help me...
I apologize. I'm sorry for blindly believing what\nI saw and heard...I've still got a lot to learn.
As a human being, as a ninja, and as the leader of\nLeafy Sakura...
Since you understand now, you should start your\ntraining over again.
Train that huge flying squirrel and come back\nagain when you feel confident! I'll fight you\nthen!
Hey, Caylass!\nPlease be a little more gentle with your words~!
I appreciate your guidance, Caylass.\nWhile training, I'll quietly continue to carry out\nmy duties in Leafy Sakura.
I shall excuse myself then...
Oh dear, she's completely bummed out. Well,\nI guess that means no duel requests for a while.\nThat's one less thing for me to worry about.
Alright, here. The reward I promised you.\nThanks for your help.
Back to our conversation earlier though. All of\nthis happened because of your rough behavior.\nShouldn't you be sorry for that?
Hahaha, my bad.
Princess Nanaka looked so gloomy. I'm worried\nabout her! Let's go see her off!
So it was because of my rough behavior...
I was expecting some rough, wild swings after what\nI'd heard, but your swordplay is actually quite\ngood.
You're pretty good too for your age.\nIt's been a while since a blade got this close and\nmade cold sweat run down the back of my neck.
So, shall we consider this a draw?
It can't be helped.\nIf we keep fighting, one of us is gonna die.
Anyway, sorry for pestering you to fight me.\nBut hey, thanks, I really enjoyed it.
I guess I owe you one now.\nIf you ever need my help, just let me know!\nI'll be happy to help!
In that case, I'll take you up on your offer.\nI need your help with something.
What is it?
Actually, I've contracted quite a serious illness.\nSoon I'll have to retire from my position as the\nleader of Leafy Sakura.
I'm shocked.\nI mean, you can still fight so well.\nHow is that possible?
I've spoken with the former leaders of the\nvillage, and we've decided that my daughter,\nNanaka, will be the next leader...
However, Nanaka is quite shy, and she still needs\nto improve her skills. She's somewhat lacking the\nqualities needed to be the leader of Leafy Sakura.
So?
I'll slip away, looking like the defeated one.\nDespite knowing she stands no chance, it's likely\nthat Nanaka will challenge you to restore
Leafy Sakura's honor. Could you go easy on her to\nignite her fighting spirit and show her what it\ntakes to be a leader?
Man, that's troublesome.\nBesides, I have to go easy on her.\nThat’s exactly the kind of acting I’m terrible at.
Come on, you can do it.\nIn fact, you're the only one who can do this.
I guess I can't say no now since I just said I'd\nhelp when you need it. Fine, I'll do what I can.
Thank you,
One day you will come back, right?\nYou won't be gone forever, will you?
I must admit, I have a soft spot for my daughter.
If I hear rumors about Nanaka becoming a\nsuccessful leader, I'm sure I'll come back to take\na peek.
Yo, looks like it's gonna wrap up nicely!
Good job...
Hm? Why is your face like that...?
Wait, don't tell me you knew it all along?
It was wonderful, especially considering it was\nyou who did it. I'll praise you this time.
Tch, next time don't just show up after everything\nis over!
Well, even though I ended up dragging the\nadventurers into this mess, I'm glad they came.\nI wasn't sure how to handle it on my own.
